story.titleZh: 勒克莱尔：总结今日所学，力争明日进步
story.summaryZh: 勒克莱尔在周四练习后表示，车队将总结当天所学，争取在明日有所进步，并希望在正赛排位中表现更强。
story.originalTitle: Charles 🗣️"We will go through everything we learned today and work on making a step forward ahead of tomorrow. Hopefully we can come back stronger...
story.summaryEn:
Charles 🗣️"We will go through everything we learned today and work on making a step forward ahead of tomorrow. Hopefully we can come back stronger for qualifying on a track that I really enjoy driving.”
A Thursday on track 🇦🇿
detailZh:
查尔斯 🗣️“我们会梳理今天学到的一切，并努力在明天之前取得进步。希望我们能在排位赛中更加强大，这条赛道我非常喜欢驾驶。”
赛道上的星期四 🇦🇿
detailEn:
Charles 🗣️"We will go through everything we learned today and work on making a step forward ahead of tomorrow. Hopefully we can come back stronger for qualifying on a track that I really enjoy driving.”
A Thursday on track 🇦🇿
